name: svga-editor
description: Animate user-provided image assets in ChatGPT and export SVGA, GIF, and animated WebP files.

interface.longDescription: Upload an image asset and add a short looping animation directly in ChatGPT. Choose fade, pulse, float, shine, glow, particles, or a combined VIP effect, refine the settings in an embedded preview, and export SVGA, GIF, or animated WebP. The first release focuses on short transparent design assets, limits browser-side rendering to a 640px maximum edge for predictable performance, and uses the first decoded frame of animated input files.
defaultPrompt: Add a premium gold shine and particles to this image and export all formats.
Make this asset pulse softly for 3 seconds and export SVGA and WebP.
Add a clean glow animation to this image and export a GIF.
